quote: Since the beginning of the war, we have eliminated over 13,000 terrorists.
caveat: IDF Spokesperson Daniel Hagari, press briefing of 29 February 2024. Given in the briefing's Gaza update; the briefing does not say whether it includes attackers killed inside Israel on 7 October. Not independently verified.
